decisions.evidence: R1 maker: presents 'Add ... edit' save flow; R1 client: 'When I paste a URL, I have to type the title (and description) myself — the form even requires a title before it'll save. What I really want is: I drop in a link and the app pulls in the page's title and description on its own, and then I can tweak them if I like.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Presented save flow diverges from REF-BM-02 (auto-collect title/description) and REF-BM-03 (editable auto-collected metadata) — no auto-fetch and title mandatory. Client identifies the mismatch (required manual title) and supplies the reference-conforming behaviour (auto-fill then editable) → corrective/correct. Confirmed fixed in R2.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'favorite, archive, and restore'; R1 client: 'There's no "read later" / unread. I can favorite things, but favoriting isn't the same ... I'd want to mark a bookmark as unread and then see just my unread ones in their own view, and clear them once I've read them.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Presented scope offered favorite but omitted the read-later feature set (REF-BM-17 mark unread, REF-BM-18 separate unread view, REF-BM-19 mark read to clear). Client distinguishes favorite from unread and requests the missing related requirements → corrective/extend. Confirmed fixed in R2.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Add, edit, delete'; R1 client: 'I can see the everyday things I'd want: adding, editing, deleting'.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Presented add/edit/delete conform to REF-BM-01/04/05; client acknowledges them as working. In-scope conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'tag filters'; R1 client: 'tagging, searching ... keeping links in collections'.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Tag assignment and tag filtering presented and acknowledged, conforming to REF-BM-09/11.

Prototype review. Basic search presented and acknowledged, conforming to REF-BM-12. Advanced operators/phrase/#tag (REF-BM-13..16) were not presented as distinct decisions, so no divergence can be established.
Prototype review. Sorting presented and acknowledged, conforming to REF-BM-22.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'archive, and restore'; R1 client: 'The archive-vs-delete distinction works the way I'd hope too.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Archive (reversible) vs delete presented and explicitly acknowledged as conforming to REF-BM-26/27; archive/restore implies the separate archive view (REF-BM-28). In-scope conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker: 'Pasting a URL now automatically fetches its page title and description. Metadata remains editable before saving. Title is no longer required'; R2 client: 'I pasted a link and it pulled in the title on its own, and I could still change it before saving'.
decisions.note: Implementation review. Revised presentation now conforms to REF-BM-02/03; conforming decision (the divergence was already captured and counted in R1, not double-counted here).

decisions.evidence: R2 maker: 'New bookmarks default to unread ... dedicated Unread view with a live count ... one-click Read/Unread toggle'; R2 client: 'new links start as unread, there's an Unread view with a running count, and I can flip something to read (or back) in one tap.'
decisions.note: Implementation review. Revised presentation now conforms to REF-BM-17/18/19; conforming decision (divergence already captured and counted in R1, not double-counted here).
